dialogues.speaker: Ajaw
dialogues.text: Oh for the love of— What kind of third-rate literary landfill is this? Not one single volume in the whole crummy place extols the illustrious, incomparable achievements of the Almighty Dragonlord, K'uhul Ajaw!

dialogues.speaker: Kinich
dialogues.text: Save your strength. You know your station.

dialogues.speaker: Kinich
dialogues.text: In the end, most of these are no more than the shallow opinions of others. I'd advise you not to halt your journey on their account. It's not worth it.
